findings.highlight: we didn't stop holding hands until we got home.
findings.evidenceJa: 結局ほどけずにここまで来てしまった
findings.governingReading: 結局ほどけずにここまで来てしまった says they reached home still holding hands; later25 explicitly continues the clasp.
findings.explanation: Arriving still unable to release hands becomes stopping at arrival.

findings.highlight: I decided to check here as a last resort
findings.evidenceJa: 最後にはここに戻ってくると踏んではいた
findings.governingReading: 最後にはここに戻ってくると踏んでいた locates the expectation at their eventual return, not Rin's failed prior search.
findings.explanation: Expecting eventual return becomes checking the house as a last resort.
